originalIntent: Euro NCAP VRU AEB CPNCO (obstructed pedestrian) protocol. This is the criterion the whole category exists for: an "occlusion" scenario in which the sight line was never blocked is a plain dart-out that has been mislabelled. Round 6 admitted ten such archetypes. Bands are pre-registered from published test protocols, not fitted to observed results.
title: Occluded emergence: the target must be genuinely hidden and then revealed before the conflict
